description: A complete roadmap to become an AI/LLM Engineer in 2026. Free & paid courses, 5 portfolio projects, interview prep, and resources. For software engineers with Python & ML basics who want to break into AI. Covers Transformers, RAG, fine-tuning, agents, LangChain, MLOps, and deployment.
